summary: Making a library file's commits durable a few seconds after they are made, with a checkpoint of its write-ahead log.
work: A passive checkpoint through a short-lived connection of its own: on the checkpoint worker's thread 2 s after the last commit (at most 5 s after the first under steady saving), and at once on the host's thread when the library closes.

done.description: Every committed frame reached the disk; false when a reader or another checkpoint held part of the log.

cancel: The library's lifetime ends: pending timers stop and the last flush runs at once on the host's thread.
cleanup: Nothing: the checkpoint's connection is closed after each run.
deadline: Unbounded; an unfinished flush is retried 2 s later, doubling to 30 s.
lane: host, checkpoint worker thread, one flush per file at a time

faults.when: The checkpoint failed or couldn't open the file.
